title: Total power loss at 100 kt and autorotation
flown: trimmed 100 kt at 4000 ft (the 40 s of autorotation need the height; from 1000 ft the ground comes first); both engines fail at t = 0; controls fixed 1.0 s; collective full down over 1.0 s; from t = 2 s the autopilot in its autorotation mode flies 65 kt with the cyclic and balances with the pedals (at 65 kt mostly the ball: blended from nose-on-track at 40 kt to ball-centred at 80 kt); the collective stays full down
